messages.subject: Order L-48341
messages.text:
Hello,

I would like to inquire about the expected delivery date for my order (subject). Next week will mark 4 weeks weeks since I placed my order for seeds. The email you sent me on the 24th indicated that my package was on its way, but I currently have no way to track its status. 

I paid $7 for shipping and would expect the delivery to occur within a reasonable timeframe.

Thank you for your assistance.

Donald

Sent from my iPhone

messages.subject: Re: Order L-48341
messages.text:
Hello Donald,
 

 Your order was shipped on March 24. Milkweed seed orders are mailed via regular post, with a stamp. Therefore there is no tracking number like with parcels.
 

 It can take between 5 and 12 business days to arrive, depending on the destination. It should arrive soon!
 

 Normally, stamped mailings cost $2.99. We will look into a refund of the difference.
 

 Warmly,
 __
 Hari 
 

 Lasclay

messages.subject: Re: Order L-48341
messages.text:
Hello, 
 I am very disappointed at the service and product from Lasclay.
 
 Here is my order. It states seed bombs
 
 
 
 This is what I received. I tiny packet of seeds in sand.
 
 The packet does not say seed bomb (I also know what they look like from a previous order) and I find it very difficult to accept that I paid $27.89 including shipping and received a useless mess. Also, $6.99 for a plain envelope and a stamp? Really? 
 
 
 
 
 When I opened the envelope, the seeds had already germinated and was a tangle of roots that could not be taken apart.
 
 The first picture is after I placed the seeds in water to see if I could untangle them. I couldn’t. The second picture is of the one tangle of roots out of water.
 
 
 
 
 
 In addition, I ordered the product on March 14 and did not receive it until April 8. I’m not sure why you would send seeds in a moist packet, and if it was necessary to do so, not ship over night. 
 
 I would like a complete refund of $27.98.
 
 Thank you,
 Donald

To ensure optimal quality and a better experience, our seed bombs are being replaced with our cold-stratified milkweed seeds, ready to sow: https://lasclay.com/en/products/cold-stratified-milkweed-seeds
 🌿 Same species as in the seed bombs
🌿 Easier germination thanks to stratification
🌿 Simple and straightforward to use
🌿 The price remains the same 🙂

We remain at your disposal for any information; we’d be happy to help.

 

 Warmly,

messages.text:
Hi Donald,

You're right, and I'll process your refund today.

What you received wasn't what you ordered, and the seeds arrived in a state where they couldn't be used. Your refund request is completely legitimate, and I'm sorry for the frustration this caused, along with the long delay in getting back to you on this.

You'll get a confirmation email once the refund goes through, and it may take a few business days to show up on your statement depending on your payment method.

Warmly,
__
 Gabriel Gouveia 
Co-founder
Lasclay.com
